info.title: Payment Processing API
info.description:
Event-driven payment processing system.

## Overview
Accepts payment requests, processes them asynchronously through Kafka,
and calls a payment gateway. Provides idempotency, state machine
guarantees, and reconciliation for stuck payments.

## Key concepts
- **Idempotency**: Use the `idempotencyKey` field to safely retry
  requests. The same key returns the same payment.
- **Async processing**: A successful POST returns 202 with status
  PENDING. The payment processes asynchronously and transitions to
  SUCCESS, FAILED, or UNKNOWN.
- **Correlation**: Pass an `X-Correlation-Id` header to trace requests
  across logs.

post.description:
Creates a payment for the given order and starts asynchronous processing.

The response returns immediately with status PENDING. The payment is then
processed via Kafka: the consumer calls the payment gateway and transitions
the payment to SUCCESS, FAILED, or UNKNOWN.

Idempotency: providing the same `idempotencyKey` on retry returns the
original payment without creating a duplicate.

State machine: an order can have at most one non-failed payment.
Subsequent POSTs for the same order are rejected with 422 unless the
previous payment failed.

400.description: Invalid request (missing fields, bad currency, etc.)

422.description: Order already has a payment in progress or paid successfully

post.summary: Approve a PENDING payment (Day 13: race-prone, intentionally)
post.description:
Promotes a payment from PENDING to SUCCESS.

⚠️ This endpoint has a known race condition under concurrent calls
for the same order. It exists to demonstrate the bug Day 14's
pessimistic locking will fix. Do not rely on this in any
production-like scenario.

500.description: Race condition — uniqueness violation under concurrency

422.description: Payment not in PENDING or order already has SUCCESS

post.summary: Approve a PENDING payment (optimistic locking, Day 15)
post.description:
Promotes a payment from PENDING to SUCCESS using optimistic
locking via @Version. No row locks are taken; conflicts are
detected at UPDATE time and resolved via retry.

Compare to POST /api/payments/{id}/approve which uses
pessimistic locking.

422.description: Payment not PENDING, or order already has SUCCESS, or retry exhaustion

get.description: Retrieves the current state of a payment, including its status.
Returns UP if the service is responsive.

orderId.description: Unique identifier of the order to pay for

amount.description: Payment amount in the smallest currency unit, e.g. paise for INR

idempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen idempotency key. Retrying with the same key returns the original payment without creating a duplicate.

webhookUrl.description: Optional URL where the system will POST status updates as the payment progresses

CreatePaymentRequest.description: Request to create a new payment

orderId.description: Order this payment was made for

status.description:
Current status of the payment.
- PENDING: just created, queued for processing
- PROCESSING: consumer is actively calling the gateway
- SUCCESS: payment completed successfully
- FAILED: gateway rejected the payment
- UNKNOWN: gateway response was lost; reconciliation will resolve

PaymentResponse.description: Payment details returned after creation or status query

message.example: Order already has a payment in progress (paymentId=..., status=PENDING)

path.description: The request path that produced the error

example: amount: amount must be greater than 0
